profile-subtitle: Tell us who the meal plans are for.
goal-subtitle: This step is optional. You can set the goal later.
allergy-question: Do you have any food allergies?
warning-dialogs-no-message: If you have an allergy and answer No, a plan may contain foods that are dangerous for you. Continue only if you are sure.
warning-dialogs-unknown-title: Plans may not be safe for you
warning-dialogs-unknown-message: If you do not know whether you have allergies, KitchenSaver cannot guarantee that a plan is free of any allergen. You use the plans at your own risk.
